description: Re-run the AI pass (summary, action items, decisions) on an edited meeting or memo. Preview by default: returns the regenerated content WITHOUT writing — note the summarization model IS still invoked (cost applies even in preview). Set apply=true to write the file (a timestamped backup is created and derived views — graph, search index, vault, QMD — refresh automatically). User edits outside AI-owned sections are never touched; checked action items and decision notes are carried forward by the merge. Docs: https://useminutes.app/docs/mcp/tools#tool-resummarize_meeting

apply.description: Write the regenerated content (default: preview only; the model is invoked either way).

engine.description: Override the summarization engine for this run (e.g. 'ollama', 'apple', 'agent'). Default: the engine from config.toml.

include_restricted.description: Resummarize a meeting designated `sensitivity: restricted` (refused by default; the override is logged).

ingest.description: With apply=true, also re-ingest the artifact into the knowledge base. Off by default because the knowledge log is append-only — every ingest adds a new log entry.

path.description: Path to the meeting/memo .md file to resummarize.

template.description: Template slug to apply for this run. Default: the template recorded in the file's frontmatter.

name: resummarize_meeting
